run_endpoint_coverage_validation: run the endpoint coverage test to validate sidebars.js against provider_endpoints_support.json
extract_endpoints_from_sidebars: extract all endpoint entries from the Supported Endpoints section of sidebars.js
check_provider_endpoint_keys: check that all endpoint keys used in providers have provider_json_field definitions
check_unused_endpoints: find endpoint definitions in provider_endpoints_support.json that are not used by any provider
normalize_endpoint_key: generate key variations for matching endpoint keys with or without underscores
